fields.summary: [API] Improve the push integration, sync push reachability to the CRM
fields.description:
Our push delivery is unreliable and we cannot tell who we can actually reach. Two parts.

Part A - clean up how we store a device token. We keep stale ones forever, we sometimes hold several for one customer, and nothing removes a token the provider has told us is dead.

Part B - sync push reachability to the CRM as a contact attribute, so that marketing automation can fall back to email for customers we cannot reach by push. Today a campaign goes out assuming push works and we find out afterwards that it did not.

Part A landed already:

|| what || where ||
| token cleanup on provider rejection | done |
| one token per device | done |
| stale token expiry job | done |

Part B is still open.
